en.text: How lovely are your dwellings, LORD of Armies!
My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the LORD. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

zhSimplified.text: 我羡慕渴想耶和华的院宇； 。

zhTraditional.text: 我羨慕渴想耶和華的院宇； 。

en.text: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, your altars, LORD of Armies, my King, and my God.

zhSimplified.text: 万军之耶和华—我的王，我的 神啊，

zhTraditional.text: 萬軍之耶和華－我的王，我的上帝啊，

en.text: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you.

zhSimplified.text: 如此住在你殿中的便为有福！

zhTraditional.text: 如此住在你殿中的便為有福！

en.text: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

zhSimplified.text: 靠你有力量、心中想往大道的，

zhTraditional.text: 靠你有力量、心中想往大道的，

en.text: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

zhSimplified.text: 他们经过「流泪谷」，叫这谷变为泉源之地；

zhTraditional.text: 他們經過「流淚谷」，叫這谷變為泉源之地；

en.text: They go from strength to strength. one of them appears before God in Zion.

zhSimplified.text: 他们行走，力上加力， 朝见 神。

zhTraditional.text: 他們行走，力上加力， 朝見上帝。

en.text: LORD, God of Armies, hear my prayer. of Jacob.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—万军之 神啊，求你听我的祷告！ 的 神啊，求你留心听！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－萬軍之上帝啊，求你聽我的禱告！ 的上帝啊，求你留心聽！

en.text: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，你是我們的盾牌；

en.text: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

zhSimplified.text: 在你的院宇住一日， 千日；

zhTraditional.text: 在你的院宇住一日， 千日；

en.text: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

zhSimplified.text: 因为耶和华— 神是日头，是盾牌，

zhTraditional.text: 因為耶和華－上帝是日頭，是盾牌，

en.text: LORD of Armies, is the man who trusts in you.
